diffab_grafted_n32.population: DiffAb in-context H3 co-design, grafted onto native IMGT scaffold, n=32

antibmpnn_fixedbb_n32.population: AntiBMPNN fixed-backbone H3 sequence design (Boltzmann platform), n=32

metric_definitions.AAR H3: CDR-H3 identity fraction, positions 95-113 (19 aa) of heavy chain, authors cal_metrics
metric_definitions.CAAR H3: AAR restricted to H3 residues in antigen contact (<6.6 A any-atom) in native
metric_definitions.RMSD(CA) aligned: whole-antibody (VH+VL) CA RMSD AFTER Kabsch superposition (compute_rmsd aligned=False applies kabsch)
metric_definitions.RMSD(CA) CDRH3: CDR-H3 CA RMSD in complex frame WITHOUT superposition (compute_rmsd aligned=True skips kabsch) — paper Appendix C Table-1 RMSD definition
metric_definitions.RMSD(CA) CDRH3 aligned: CDR-H3 CA RMSD after Kabsch superposition of the loop itself
metric_definitions.TMscore: TM-score of antibody (H+L merged), TMscore binary in repo
metric_definitions.LDDT: lDDT of antibody vs native, lddt binary (-x); agreement-to-reference, NOT predicted confidence
metric_definitions.DockQ: DockQ v1 (repo binary) on antigen vs CDR-H3-only reduced complex (cdrh3_only=True, HERN-consistent)

evaluator_provenance: AbFlow repo @ df39b47, cal_metrics.cal_metrics (same evaluator as run_001/run_004)

protocol_notes.diffab: DiffAb outputs Chothia-renumbered terminally-cropped complexes; evaluation models transplant the full-atom designed H3 block onto the native IMGT scaffold 1:1 by sequence position. ALL design content (H3 seq+structure+sidechains) is DiffAb-generated; framework/pose conditioning is the in-context protocol (native complex provided), declared separate from pose-blind AbFlow tracks.
protocol_notes.antibmpnn: AntiBMPNN designed H3 sequences on the native backbone (fixed-backbone track, user-authorized declared variant). Models = native complex with H3 residues mutated to designed sequence (backbone atoms + CB only). Sequence-recovery metrics are informative; RMSD/TM/lDDT/DockQ are structural-trivial (backbone native) and reported as such.
